name: Universal Base Suite (Base64, Base58, Base32, Hex)
desc: Encode and decode payloads simultaneously across Base64, Base64URL, Base58 (Bitcoin), Base32, Hexadecimal (Base16), and Binary in real-time. 100% client-side, zero network egress.

name: Base58 & Base62 Codec
desc: Encode and decode raw strings, hexadecimal buffers, and hashes into Bitcoin/IPFS Base58, Ripple, Flickr, and Base62 alphanumeric formats locally in browser memory. Zero network egress.

name: Universal Data & Stream Decompressor
desc: Decompress Gzip, Deflate, Deflate-Raw, Zlib, and unpack Base64 or Hex archives directly in your browser memory. Zero tracking, zero network egress.

name: Hex Dumper & Binary File Inspector
desc: Inspect binary files and raw text in canonical hexadecimal and ASCII columns with magic byte signature detection. 100% client-side, zero logs, zero network egress.

name: Apple Property List (plist) Viewer & Decoder
desc: Parse, inspect, and convert Apple binary plist (bplist00) and XML plist files directly in your browser. 100% offline, zero data upload.

name: Protobuf Raw Decoder
desc: Decode and inspect raw Protocol Buffers (Protobuf) binaries, Base64, or Hex streams in browser memory without .proto schema files. Zero network egress.

name: ROT13 Encoder & Decoder
desc: Encode, decode, and transform text using ROT13, ROT47, ROT5, and ROT18 entirely in your browser memory. 100% offline, zero network egress.

name: URL Encoder & Decoder
desc: Encode, decode, parse, and analyze URLs, query strings, and URI components securely in your browser. Zero tracking, zero network egress.
